info.title: 语学星 P1R Media, Recording and Shadowing Contract
info.description: P1R-M1-009 canonical D2 contract. Static contract only; runtime remains unverified.

tags.name: P1R-Media
tags.description: Canonical media upload, processing, manifest and access grants.

tags.name: P1R-Recording
tags.description: Adult owner-bound personal recording metadata and deletion.

post.summary: Create a server-bound one-use media upload intent

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first intent for the same principal, tenant, purpose and request digest until it expires

post.summary: Submit an opaque provider completion reference for trusted verification

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first durable verification task; a changed completion reference conflicts

get.summary: Read a media processing task without exposing worker credentials or objects

post.summary: Request retry only when the server-classified failure is transient

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the existing retry transition for the same task version and request digest

202.description: Retry accepted or existing transition returned

get.summary: Read metadata-only renditions, subtitle artifacts and playback capabilities

post.summary: Create a short-lived, scope-bound media access grant

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first unexpired grant for the same asset version, principal, channel, range and request digest

post.summary: Create an adult-consented owner-bound recording upload intent

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first intent for the same owner, source segment and request digest until it expires

post.summary: Complete a recording upload and start trusted verification

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first durable recording verification state; changed completion reference conflicts

get.summary: Read owner-bound recording metadata without audio bytes or URL

delete.summary: Request owner recording deletion subject to legal hold and retention policy

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the existing delete, hold, purge or failure receipt for the same recording and request digest

202.description: Deletion request accepted or existing state returned

post.summary: Create a server-owned 500 ms Phase 1 shadowing session

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first session for the same subject, source segment and request digest

post.summary: Record non-authoritative learner progress and self-rating

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first state transition for the same session version and request digest

post.summary: Complete a rule-based assessment-owned shadowing attempt

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first assessment receipt for the same session version and request digest

post.summary: Register a media asset (metadata only; bytes go to object storage via grants)

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first committed 201 response for the same tenant, subject, key and request digest; changed request conflicts

post.summary: Reset FAILED transcoding/renditions to QUEUED (409 when nothing failed)

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first committed retry response for the same tenant, subject, asset and key without another transition or event

post.summary: Upsert a subtitle track as a reserved rendition (VTT/SRT, zh-CN/en-US)

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first committed subtitle response for the same tenant, subject, asset, key and request digest

post.summary: Recording upload grant is unavailable until a verified PUT flow exists

503.description: No verified recording PUT grant is available; no upload URL or persistent receipt is created

put.summary: Activate an asset with client-verified checksum + size (M3-004 live)

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: return the first committed activation response for the same tenant, subject, asset, key and request digest

MediaExpectedObject.description: Client declaration only. Provider/worker verification remains authoritative.

MediaUploadIntentCompleteRequest.description: Opaque provider completion reference. Client object facts are not authoritative.

MediaSubtitleTrack.description: Artifact metadata only. Official subtitle text and review remain content-service facts.

MediaFallbackAlternative.x-availability-rule: AVAILABLE requires an opaque contentRef and reasonCode=NONE; UNAVAILABLE requires a non-NONE reasonCode.

SpeakingRecordingCompleteRequest.description: Opaque completion reference; client integrity, malware and AI claims are prohibited.

SpeakingRecordingDeleteReceipt.x-owner-receipt-rule: purgeReceiptRef is required only after owner-confirmed DELETED; all non-deleted states forbid purge success.

recordingRef.description: Null when microphone permission was denied and the learner completed silent practice.

MediaGone.description: The resource, consent, rights, grant or recording is no longer available
